mapper.select: select MEM.ID as USER_ID ,MEM.NAME ,MEM.NICKNAME ,MEM.STATUS ,CON.CONSULTANT_NO ,ORG.NAME as ORG_NAME ,count(*) as STUDENT_COUNT from CONSULTANT CON left join MEMBER MEM on (MEM.MEMBER_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO) left join ORGANIZATION ORG on (ORG.ORG_NO = CON.ORG_NO) left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS on (CS.CONSULTANT_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO) where CON.CONSULTANT_NO = #{consultantNo} group by MEM.ID ,MEM.NAME ,MEM.NICKNAME ,MEM.STATUS ,CON.CONSULTANT_NO ,ORG.NAME
